text: Istilah dunia kita dikelompokkan jadi Solaris-3, Waveworn Phenomenon, Lament, Tacet Field, Resonator, Tacet Discord, Echoes, Sentinel, Threnodian, Reverberation, dan Remnant. Kamu hafal berapa, Rover?
text_en: Our world's terms include Solaris-3, Waveworn Phenomena, Lament, Tacet Field, Resonator, Tacet Discord, Echoes, Sentinel, and Threnodian. How many do you recall?

text: Lament adalah sebutan untuk rangkaian bencana kepunahan massal di planet ini. Secara ketat, ia masih berlangsung sampai sekarang, Rover.
text_en: The Lament refers to the recurring mass-extinction catastrophes across our world. Technically, it is still ongoing to this day, Rover.

text: Black Shores mengawasi dan meredam dampak Lament lewat Tethys System, bahkan punya sistem untuk memprediksi kemunculannya.
text_en: The Black Shores monitors and mitigates Lament disasters through the Tethys System, even operating predictive models for outbreaks.

text: Waveworn Phenomenon itu kumpulan keanehan pasca-Lament: Tacet Field, Etheric Sea, Retroact Rain, sampai hilangnya gravitasi.
text_en: Waveworn Phenomena comprise post-Lament anomalies: Tacet Fields, the Etheric Sea, Retroact Rain, and even localized gravity loss.

text: Nama Mandarin Waveworn Phenomenon kira-kira berarti "erosi pantai". Nama selembut itu untuk fenomena sebesar ini, aneh ya?
text_en: The Chinese name for Waveworn Phenomenon translates roughly to "coastal erosion". Such a gentle phrase for cataclysms, don't you think?

text: Saat Resonator terbangun, muncul Tacet Mark di tubuhnya. Bentuknya ditentukan oleh Rabelle's Curve. Aku tipe Natural, kamu tipe yang mana?
text_en: When a Resonator awakens, a Tacet Mark manifests on their body, shaped by Rabelle's Curve. I'm Natural type—which one are you, Rover?

text: Rabelle's Curve membagi Resonator jadi tiga golongan: Natural, Mutant, dan Congenital, menurut kapan dan bagaimana mereka terbangun.
text_en: Rabelle's Curve categorizes Resonators into three classes: Natural, Mutant, and Congenital, based on how and when they awakened.

text: Tacet Discord terbentuk dari sisa energi frekuensi kacau. Mereka memakan frekuensi lain agar stabil, dan bentuknya ikut meniru apa yang mereka makan.
text_en: Tacet Discords form from chaotic residual frequency energy. They consume frequencies to stabilize, mimicking whatever they absorb.

text: Di dalam Tacet Discord ada Tacet Core, yang di kalangan akademisi disebut Reverberation Body. Nama yang rapi untuk makhluk yang berantakan.
text_en: Inside a Tacet Discord lies a Tacet Core, termed Reverberation Body in academia. A remarkably tidy name for such disorderly creatures.

text: Threnodian itu bentuk ketakutan manusia yang memadat. Mereka melahap kehendak yang runtuh, dan tiap Threnodian terikat pada ketakutan tertentu.
text_en: Threnodians are condensed human terrors. They feed on collapsing wills, each bound to a specific fundamental primal fear.

text: Ovathrax, Threnodian Perang, muncul di Jinzhou, tanah yang berabad-abad jadi medan tempur. Ketakutan selalu lahir di tempat yang pantas.
text_en: Ovathrax, Threnodian of War, arose in Jinzhou, a land steeped in centuries of battle. Terrors always manifest where their seeds run deepest.

text: Dalam arsip Lore umum Solaris-3, tercatat istilah penting seperti Anchoring, Arbiter (julukanmu, Rover!), Echoes, Homeland & Pre-Lament Civilization, Remnant, Resonance Beacon, serta Terminal.
text_en: General Solaris-3 lore catalogs terms like Anchoring, Arbiter (that's you, Rover!), Echoes, Homeland Civilization, Remnant, and Terminals.

text: Lore wilayah Huanglong mencakup Pangu Terminal, legenda Suan'ni, Evil Miasma, serta sejarah perang besar seperti Battle Beneath the Crescent dan Fortress and Gorges War di Jinzhou.
text_en: Huanglong lore encompasses Pangu Terminal, Suan'ni legends, Evil Miasma, and great conflicts like the Fortress and Gorges War in Jinzhou.

text: Di Black Shores, pengetahuan dunia dijaga lewat Tethys System, Stellar Matrices, bunga penanda Blake Bloom, para Left Behinds, serta robot kecil KU-Roro yang rajin membantu!
text_en: In the Black Shores, knowledge is guarded by the Tethys System, Stellar Matrices, Blake Blooms, Left Behinds, and helpful little KU-Roro bots!

text: Lore Rinascita erat dengan ancaman Dark Tide, Common Echoes, para Harbinger, kapal Pilgrim's Sail, Ragunna Terminal, serta tradisi Carnevale, Great Agon, dan Night of Remembrance.
text_en: Rinascita lore highlights the Dark Tide, Common Echoes, Harbingers, Pilgrim's Sail, Ragunna Terminal, Carnevale, and Night of Remembrance.

text: Lore Lahai-Roi meliputi Exostrider, Exoswarm, Reactor Drive, Soliskin, Heliodic Six, Heliogyre, Stargrams, Starstacks, hingga fenomena Void Storm, Shimmer, Voidspace, dan Voidworms!
text_en: Lahai-Roi lore features Exostriders, Exoswarms, Reactor Drives, Soliskin, Heliodic Six, Heliogyre, Stargrams, Void Storms, and Voidworms!

text: Wilayah Ashinohara mengenal Legacy Talismans dan Suzu, sementara di Jinzhou warga merayakan Moon-Chasing Festival dan kompetisi Riverside Games. Seru banget kalau kita ke sana, Rover!
text_en: Ashinohara is known for Legacy Talismans and Suzu, while Jinzhou celebrates Moon-Chasing Festival and Riverside Games. Exploring them together would be a blast!
